\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-58},
  title = {An unmeasured success criterion blocks the release gate},
  note = {\textbf{Absorbs EDN-60} (2026-09-30): which segments may gate is enforced in code.},
  date = {2026-09-30},
  milestone = {M3: Quality Assurance},
  topic = {Testing Strategy, Model Evaluation},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {A criterion the \texttt{evaluate} stage could not measure is recorded as \texttt{null} and blocks the NFR-01 gate.
\texttt{metrics.\allowbreak{}json} names the criteria that were not measured and counts the variants that pass everything measurable.
The rules for which segment levels SC-04 may gate on are checks in the stage: a segment that conditions on the target, or one over an optional input field, raises.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Leave an unmeasurable criterion out of the gate: a model would pass NFR-01 without any interval ever being calibrated.
\item Count SC-04 as met when no segment level reaches 500 rows: a check nobody ran would be reported as passed, on every CI run with the small fixture.
\item Document the segment rules and rely on review: one line in \texttt{params.\allowbreak{}yaml} could add the price buckets and change the number the gate blocks on.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} NFR-01 says ``every'' criterion.
SC-05 is not measurable yet, because the UC2 intervals are a later ticket, so the gate is closed and the artefact says why.
Promotion is a pull-request review (EDN-12) and the reviewer reads the metrics diff, so the artefact has to explain itself.},
  ai = {Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted with modifications},
  assessment = {AI laid out the readings and recommended the blocking one.
It measured that no segment level reaches 500 rows on the test fixture, so the suite evaluates a second time with a lower bar and gets a real verdict.
We moved the worst segment and the per-field sweep out of \texttt{metrics.\allowbreak{}json} into the per-variant records, and added a check AI had not proposed: a gating segment must be a required input field.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-09-30 on issue \#39.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/metrics.json}{\texttt{metrics.\allowbreak{}json}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/recommenditos/modeling/evaluate.py}{\texttt{evaluate.\allowbreak{}py}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/tests/test_pipeline.py}{\texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}test\_\allowbreak{}pipeline.\allowbreak{}py}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/39}{issue \#39}.},
